## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2 (partial Python side): Per-Finding Processing Protocol implemented in Python consumer
- DD3 (partial Python side): BLOCK-gate AND-logic enforced in Python validation
- DD4 (partial Python side): CoVe soft-cap: DEFER when cycle > max_cycles
- DD5: dso_ci_review/arbiter.py and its test suite updated to consume new BLOCK/DEFER/DROP schema; old SUSTAIN/ACCEPT/DOWNGRADE strings removed; CI tests pass
- DD7: Arbiter output includes schema_version field matching cycle-ledger schema version convention

## Overview
Rewrite `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter.py` to:
1. Remove `validate_arbiter_ruling` (DOWNGRADE_TO/ACCEPT_DEFENSE logic) — entirely replaced
2. Add `validate_cycle_end_ruling(ruling: dict) -> dict` — validates each finding's ruling against the BLOCK/DEFER/DROP enum; raises ValueError on unknown ruling values
3. Add `dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter(findings, defenses, diff_text, model, provider_chain, cycle_num, max_cycles) -> list[dict]` — dispatches the arbiter agent for cycle-end consolidation, returns per-finding ruling list
4. Each ruling in the returned list must include `schema_version: "1.0.0"` (from cycle-ledger convention)
5. BLOCK-gate AND-logic validation: after receiving arbiter LLM response, validate each ruling's BLOCK claim matches AND-conditions (severity critical/important, defense absent/rejected, cycle_num <= max_cycles); if BLOCK issued when cycle_num > max_cycles, reclassify to DEFER
6. Exhaustiveness assertion: after parsing all rulings, assert every finding has exactly one of BLOCK/DEFER/DROP; fail loudly on unknown ruling

## Key design constraints
- `dispatch_arbiter` (the old per-finding function) may be kept as a thin wrapper for backward compat with runner.py callers — but it MUST NOT reference old schema strings
- `validate_arbiter_ruling` (old function) MUST be removed — it is the primary source of old schema
- `_FILE_LINE_RE` pattern can be removed (it was only used in validate_arbiter_ruling)
- Public API: `dispatch_arbiter`, `validate_cycle_end_ruling`, `dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter`
- Consumer in runner.py: check grep in runner.py for dispatch_arbiter calls — the old call site at RESUSTAIN_OF handling (line ~808) uses dispatch_arbiter; this must be updated to use cycle-end semantics or removed if no longer needed

## File Impact
- `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter.py` — MODIFY (behavior change: replace entire logic)

## TDD Requirement
This task depends on T1 (test_arbiter.py already updated with RED tests). Run T1 first to confirm tests fail, then implement this task to make them GREEN.

Run before implementing:
  python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py -x
Expected: FAILED (RED state from T1)

After implementing, run:
  python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py -x
Expected: PASSED (GREEN)

## Consumer Detection
- `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py`: contains a RESUSTAIN_OF check (line ~808) that currently calls dispatch_arbiter implicitly via the novelty gate. Since runner.py does NOT directly import dispatch_arbiter (grep shows no direct import), this is an indirect consumer through the pipeline. Verify: `grep -n "dispatch_arbiter\|validate_arbiter_ruling\|from dso_ci_review.arbiter" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py` — if any imports exist, they must be updated. Disposition: if RESUSTAIN_OF path in runner.py now delegates to cycle-end arbiter, update the call site; if the old per-finding dispatch_arbiter is still needed, keep it but without old schema strings.

## Implementation Steps
1. Remove `validate_arbiter_ruling` function and `_FILE_LINE_RE` pattern entirely
2. Add `VALID_RULINGS = frozenset({"BLOCK", "DEFER", "DROP"})` constant
3. Add `validate_cycle_end_ruling(ruling: dict) -> dict` — checks `ruling["ruling"]` in VALID_RULINGS; raises `ValueError` if not; returns ruling unchanged if valid
4. Add `_enforce_cove_fallback(ruling: dict, cycle_num: int, max_cycles: int) -> dict` — if ruling is BLOCK but cycle_num > max_cycles, reclassify to DEFER
5. Update `dispatch_arbiter` docstring to not reference old schema strings; keep function signature but update return documentation
6. Add `dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter` function that dispatches the cycle-end arbiter agent and processes per-finding results
7. Ensure `schema_version: "1.0.0"` is injected into each ruling dict if absent (matches cycle-ledger convention from S2/aead-ae88)
8. Run ruff format + ruff check to pass lint

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py -x 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] validate_arbiter_ruling is removed from arbiter.py
  Verify: ! grep -q "def validate_arbiter_ruling" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter.py
- [ ] VALID_RULINGS constant defined with BLOCK/DEFER/DROP
  Verify: grep -q 'VALID_RULINGS.*BLOCK.*DEFER.*DROP\|BLOCK.*DEFER.*DROP.*VALID' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter.py
- [ ] validate_cycle_end_ruling function exists
  Verify: grep -q "def validate_cycle_end_ruling" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter.py
- [ ] schema_version injected in cycle-end ruling output
  Verify: grep -q "schema_version" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter.py
- [ ] No old verdict strings remain in arbiter.py
  Verify: ! grep -q "SUSTAIN_AT_SEVERITY\|ACCEPT_DEFENSE\|DOWNGRADE_TO" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter.py
- [ ] CoVe fallback: BLOCK reclassified to DEFER when cycle > max_cycles
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py -k "defer_when_cycle_exceeds" -x 2>&1 | tail -3
- [ ] Exhaustiveness check: ValueError raised for unknown ruling
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py -k "unknown_ruling" -x 2>&1 | tail -3

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Rewrite arbiter.py: BLOCK/DEFER/DROP validation, per-finding processing, schema_version field
